Mobile phone manufacturers, such as Apple and Samsung, have targeted students as their main market and thus they have designed various models with lots of features in order to attract them. Despite the fact that the use of mobile phones by students in schools can be used positively and constructively in order to enhance their learning, the same technological devices can be utilized negatively, which distracts them and their teachers and in turn disrupts the learning process. For instance, whilst the students can use mobile phones positively by accessing or downloading important academic materials from the worldwide web, the same can also be used to get access towards destructive pornographic or undesirable contents from online sources thus destroying students’ morals. There are various reasons as to why mobile phones should not be used by students in schools and other learning institutions through giving tangible evidence. There are various arguments from critics calling for the use of mobile phones in schools by the students.

rows: ABILITY- to say someone has (or hasn’t) a particular ability.
● Lito can speak 5 dialects fluently, but she can’t speak English fluently.
POSSIBILITY -to express possibility about the present or the future.
● It might be raining outside, you should take an umbrella with you. ● I may come and visit you after work. ● It could rain later, so I will bring an umbrella with me.
● She speaks 5 dialects, so she must be clever.
● You should buy some new shoes. ● You ought to go to sleep early, you look tired. ● You must be careful and alert when driving alone.
● You must finish your task by this afternoon. She has to feed her pet ● everyday.
c2be4c6d5aef80cf586c.text: Modal Verbs Expressions Examples Can/Can’t (present) Could/Couldn’t (past) ABILITY- to say someone has (or hasn’t) a particular ability. ● Lito can speak 5 dialects fluently, but she can’t speak English fluently. Could/Might/May (present and future) POSSIBILITY -to express possibility about the present or the future. ● It might be raining outside, you should take an umbrella with you. ● I may come and visit you after work. ● It could rain later, so I will bring an umbrella with me. Must/ Must Have (present/past) CERTAINTY – to express certainty. ● She speaks 5 dialects, so she must be clever. Should/ought to/Must ADVICE – to give advice. ● You should buy some new shoes. ● You ought to go to sleep early, you look tired. ● You must be careful and alert when driving alone. Must/Have to OBLIGATION – expresses strong obligation. ● You must finish your task by this afternoon. She has to feed her pet ● everyday.

9a0ed8e1d29db9b7e7eb.text: Modal Adverbs are used to modify specific verbs that consist of a linking verb (verb of being) and sometimes another verb.

226a144db97ca68212b0.text: Here are examples of modal adverbs: probably, possibly, evidently, certainly, surely, undoubtedly, seriously, clearly, obviously

bc543cb5fc89a57f5c5b.text: 1. I will surely watch the Avengers movie. 2. It will probably rain this afternoon. 3. Ruben must seriously exert more effort in his studies to pass this final quarter.

466a9092bff504d7ae60.text: It is used in writing to express how definite you are about something.

9857bacf8308630b017b.text: 1. STRONG – uses the adverbs always and never, evidently, surely, seriously and undoubtedly

47cf27870d3774e5b622.text: Example: People should always wash their hands before eating. You will never graduate fi you will not study hard.

190f336990e85d6e78d6.text: 2. MODERATE – uses often, rarely, usually, sometimes, frequently, and occasionally

a2e81924fa1faf4ea831.text: Example: Mary rarely goes out to party. Arnold often takes a bath.

7d3b62628cbda303c277.text: Some adverbs can be used to describe how likely it is that something will happen. These are called ‘adverbs of possibility.

095e36fa605a7305ecc0.text: Some of the most common adverbs of possibility are:

ba7450f19ca840e423e5.text: certainly definitely maybe possibly obviously perhaps probably clearly

79d75e2efb27f66dee67.text: Directions: Read the presented argumentative essay below. Underline each modal (verbs and adverbs) used.

7df4d7895750b7f27b12.text: Cell phones have enabled Americans to travel with technology everywhere they

8ee006701be9be0f1d79.text: go. This allows many users to access and share the radio bandwidth. What is more, cell phones also allow calls to be made in a wide geographical area. The user does not have to own the station. Being a subscriber is the only thing required. Cordless telephones are completely different from cell phones as they can be used only in the area of one personal base station.

9d98260c9e28742e05a0.text: Indisputably, ever since the emergence of cell phones, people can constantly

a1d3076aef33a5db0775.text: keep in touch with their loved ones, regardless of the distance. One can reach almost everywhere without any difficulty. When in the past years, people were separated by distance for some reason, and it took forever to write, to send, and to deliver a single letter. Today, it takes a couple of quick clicks, and you see the face of your significant other, parent, or friend real-time! In addition, people can immediately get help in case

7668406a9067f36c9c78.text: of emergencies. Furthermore, by means of mobile phones, people can lessen their boredom through listening to their favorite music or watching downloaded movies.

cbb79d3bbb3b4dcefc01.text: In general, the invention of cell phones has led to massive changes in the

37f034f99376e2c20617.text: Philippines. In the main, people began to spend many hours talking on cell phones. Filipino culture has tremendously changed with the emergence of cell phones. Minor firms now market cell phone games, as well as video content aimed specifically to be watched on cell phones. Additionally, other creative functions have arisen, such as text messaging, Short Message Service (SMS), as well as fake talking (people pretend to converse using cell phones to fight fear and loneliness). In the situations when young people (men and women) are controlled in their capability to socialize, cellular phones have been helpful for social interaction.

1596f5268ca7ea3b7f54.text: Cell phones have an effect on Filipino’s built environment, especially through

b6a9e1dba4d7f92a2104.text: widespread advertising. Cell phones have grown to be popular in the Philippines, unlike the Internet. The latter, on the other hand, has caused digital division between various social classes. It is also recognized to be glamorous and inexpensive. The majority of the cell phone subscribers in the Philippines personalize and decorate their cell phones, bringing about folk-art cottage sector. The cell phone has grown to be some kind of art, whereby a cell phone user’s preference of phone and decoration serves as a sort of personal statement.

2ee529c4ee6c0af9dfd6.text: The emergence of the mobile cellular phone has as well brought about changes

c7e2d8602f19f0a5cd3c.text: in various cultural norms in the Philippines. Industries, movie theaters, cafés, and parks are just a number of spaces where the suitability of cell phone discussions is unclear and doubtful. Cell phones prioritize socialization with people who are far away over those who share space.

ab0d19efb4f8e8df8d95.text: Classrooms are also other sectors that have significantly changed in the

cf64f1d5bb7b442a43a6.text: Philippines due to the use of cell phones. Nowadays, the majority of students use cell phones in class, especially when it comes to text messaging and the internet. Students can now get information faster through the cell phones. This has significantly affected education standards since most of the students use cell phones to cheat during exams. But the reality is that cell phones have successfully turned into a powerful learning tool. All cell phones that were primarily used to engage students in class create personal computer access points that guarantee better academic results. A lot of schools all over the globe encourage a special policy that encourages students to bring their own devices in order to boost students learning abilities. Even though academic progress might be hurt when undergrads use their phones just to entertain, coupled with financial problems that exist in this or that region, well-arranged content access is absolutely beneficial.

59b4085786262253c03c.text: Despite the presence of moderately small screen sizes, the majority of people

d77b79eaad631304ddbe.text: in the Philippines have started watching TV on their cell phones. They prefer this way in order to distance themselves from jam-packed situations and also prioritize their attention. Regardless of the widespread recognition of the cell phones’ video technology, consumers are still cautious of two-way video, caused by anxieties about privacy and surveillance. The political sector in the Philippines has also changed tremendously as a result of cell phones. Cell phones have been utilized to mobilize followers for political causes. Protesters use their cell phones to send text messages to organize activities, as well as avoid the police.

9c509b8ecb5425ea5e0c.text: Obviously, the whole range of advantages that we’ve just discussed make cell

6eb9feef06f255fb38d5.text: phone market in the Philippines is very dynamic and competitive. This has enabled expansion of international trade between the Philippines and other countries.

fcc7230859a0dd67d963.text: In conclusion, cell phones have enabled people to form their own micro-

30f944e743906f4085b1.text: cultures. In the Philippines, people are changing cultural customs and values, and are greatly demonstrating consumers’ skills to repurpose and modify technology for their personal use. In my opinion, the invention called “a cell phone” has allowed people in the Philippines to protect their private relations from the culture in their surroundings. What is more, these devices have encouraged the existence of a great variety of complex but exclusive micro-cultures.

2e76f045da6862ab075e.text: An argumentative essay is a type of essay that presents arguments about both

5f49f7beb9fcd4fca1c0.text: sides of an issue. It could be that both sides are presented equally balanced, or it could be that one side is presented more forcefully than the other. It all depends on the writer, and what side he supports the most.

af7ea6b324dae9e13d57.text: An argumentative essay is usually written in the five-paragraph structure. The

cb0b0e6b00146cb37528.text: argumentative essay format consists of an introduction, 2-3 body paragraphs, and a conclusion. Logically, each of those three sections will have a unique structure, so understanding them on an individual level will help ensure a smooth writing process. The thesis statement is part of the introduction. It is a concise, one sentence summary of your main point or claim.

7283add3fefa782313f8.text: Modal verbs and modal adverbs are used in writing argumentative essays or

f3460072fc2fee1971d8.text: text to prove and to have a strong stand in a position you believed in.

902352a0f9179429565e.text: Use modals to soften your verbs.

c5bd3e7c120646f533da.text: Example: The President must change his policy. (“must” is too strong) The

25fe5e0142457bfe6696.text: We should control the TONE with MODALS. Remember that good writers are

0364113f1bea7d064ee1.text: always aware of how their arguments sound. Certain words can help control the tone of the argument.

ff1dc6183a5db61fdfe7.text: Modal verbs are often used to make the writer's claims more or less tentative, i.e. to

92ee830655174946fbc4.text: suggest that the writer thinks something is more or less probable. One of the weaknesses of student essays is making strong claims that cannot be supported. In these cases, it is useful to be able to vary the strength of a claim to suit the circumstances.
